event_name: Document 18 Date 07 September 2019 Time 12:35 2019 ITALIAN GRAND PRIX 5 - 8 September 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (document 17), have considered the following matter and determine the following

reason: The penalty is imposed in accordance to with Article 23.3 b) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations. This penalty does not change the fact that the competitor is required to start the race from the rear of the starting grid for a prior infringement (document 9).
